sn12.4:1.2: The story of Vipassī is detailed in the Mahāpadāna Sutta, with which this passage is mostly shared ([dn14:2.18.5]()). Here we have the normal twelve links, whereas in DN 14 the sequence omits ignorance and choices, emphasizing rather the mutual interdependence of consciousness with name and form.
